test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question:
The question below consists of two statements labelled I and II. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and give your answer.

Six people P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing towards centre.

Question: What is the position of R with respect to P?

I. R sits second to the left of S. Neither U nor Q sits opposite T. U sits adjacent to R.

II. Q sits opposite R. U and T are immediate neighbour of R. S sits to the immediate right of T.

options.text: The information given in statement I alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in statement II alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in either statement I or statement II alone is sufficient to answer this question.
The information given in both statements I and II together is sufficient to answer this question.

solution:
According to the given information:

Six people P, Q, R, S, T, and U are sitting around a circular table facing towards centre.

Considering Statement I alone:

I. R sits second to the left of S. Neither U nor Q sits opposite T. U sits adjacent to R.

Therefore, the information given in statement I alone is not sufficient to answer this question.

Considering Statement II alone:

II. Q sits opposite R. U and T are immediate neighbour of R. S sits to the immediate right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b4276e9df46fb6190472b0c70a3813f1368fdf431cab8c2cd684ad0b472113b.png] 

Here, the position of R with respect to P is second to the right.

Hence, the correct answer is **'The information given in statement II alone is sufficient to answer this question'.**
